notice.limitationOfData: There are limitations associated with food composition databases. Food composition data used in the database or databases may represent an average of the nutrient content of a particular sample of foods and ingredients, determined at a particular time. The nutrient composition of foods and ingredients can vary substantially between batches and brands because of a number of factors, including changes in season, processing practices and ingredient source, and methods of calculation.
notice.australianData: This Work is based on Australian data, and Australian data may not be appropriate for use in other countries.

definitions.energy: Energy in kcal converted from the AFCD's kJ (4.184 kJ per kcal), with dietary fibre at 8 kJ/g: protein 17, fat 37, available carbohydrate 17 (sugars 16), alcohol 29 kJ/g and so on. These are not the factors of the Australia New Zealand Food Standards Code, Standard 1.2.8
definitions.protein: Total nitrogen x the food's nitrogen factor
definitions.satfat: Sum of the saturated fatty acids
definitions.carbohydrate: Available carbohydrate by weight: sugars + starch + other available carbohydrates + sugar alcohols (not by difference; excludes fibre). For a few foods it comes from the label and may be by difference
definitions.sugars: Fructose + glucose + sucrose + maltose + lactose + galactose
definitions.vitaminA: Retinol equivalents: retinol + beta-carotene/6 + alpha-carotene/12 + cryptoxanthin/12 (the UK and EU definition; US targets use retinol activity equivalents)
definitions.vitaminD: Vitamin D3 equivalents: cholecalciferol + ergocalciferol + 5 x 25-hydroxycholecalciferol + 5 x 25-hydroxyergocalciferol (the other tables count D2 + D3 only)
definitions.niacinNE: Niacin equivalents as published: niacin + tryptophan x 0.017
definitions.folate: Dietary folate equivalents: natural folate + 1.67 x folic acid (the US and EU definition; UK targets use total folate)
definitions.epa: C20:5 n-3, converted from mg to g
definitions.dha: C22:6 n-3, converted from mg to g
definitions.histidine: Amino acids converted from mg to g per 100 g
definitions.cystine: Cystine and cysteine together (the AFCD does not give them separately)
